reviews.text: What a lovely place to take your pet when needed; the veterinarian(s) and staff take their time and provide perfect care (and aftercare)! They go that extra mile, making the overall experience very pleasant and professional. I am very satisfied and wholeheartedly recommend them if you want to give your pet truly good care. Plus, they have delicious coffee; truly a top-notch team!
Very nice team and the treatment went well
We took both our cavalier King Charles for dentals and full check ups and we couldn’t be happier . They left the surgeries happy and heal super quick :) really friendly team . So happy we found them

I cannot recommend Dierenkliniek Westlandgracht enough! They have been wonderful in taking care of my puppy, Tyche. The entire team is professional, kind, and truly cares about their animal patients.  They gave valuable advises. They walked us through her diagnosis and treatment with great patience and expertise. Thank you to Sarah, Sarina and the rest of the staff for always providing such exceptional care!

We received excellent help at this veterinary clinic from veterinarian Sarah. As new clients, we were able to get an appointment immediately for an emergency with our cat. Sarah is skilled and very transparent about the treatment and the associated costs. She even kept us updated on the blood test results over the weekend and gave tips on the best course of action. She shows a great deal of dedication and attention towards the animals. I definitely recommend this veterinary clinic.
A huge improvement compared to my previous vet. The staff is super friendly and really thinks along with you. They take into account what is suitable and desired for you. Super happy with them!

The team is amazing. They took such good care of Kuro, my cat. He came in for a dental cleaning. I was provided with a detailed preparation before his appointment. The day of his appointment I was able to stay by his side until he was sedated. They also did X-rays to see if any teeth needed to be extracted. Unfortunately, two teeth needed to get extracted but luckily done on the same day. The whole team was kind, helpful, and always in good spirits.

My cat suddenly had a strange spot on her neck and I was able to get her in before closing time. Upon arrival, my cat had escaped from the carrier and dove under a car… the whole team came out and worked hard to get my cat safely inside. I am incredibly grateful to them for their help and compassion!! A super sweet team and my cat was helped with great love.

Good evening, I would like to give this veterinary clinic a 5-star rating. Primarily because they received me and my cat very well and kindly, treated me, and resolved my cat's problem. Furthermore, it is a clinic that lets you know you should prepare for the worst, and that the bill could be hefty. When I received a call to say I could pick up my cat, she was fortunately okay to go home again. Also, the bill (which the clinic absolutely deserved) was reasonable, whereas I had expected it to be much higher. All in all, my cat is home, was treated perfectly, and from now on, this clinic is my go-to place whenever I have a problem with my dearest cat. 5 stars
We've enrolled our dog to this clinic. We didn't have serious incidents but we are happy with minor treatments so far.

Such caring staffs, you see that they really like the pets and are more than open to help you with.
Jesse was super kind and threat my dog super good, he felt super comfortable on the vet.
Special thanks to Sarina, she explained me about the dog passaport and helped me with that as well.
I’m super lucky to find this place ❤️

I arrived at this clinic as a new client and was immediately put straight to the point. My cat had acute or chronic kidney failure. The care we received was the very best I could have wished for Molly. The support we received from the entire clinic was truly special. Also, when my other cat Chloe needed dental work shortly afterwards, the care was fantastic once again. The costs are fair, clear, and everything is discussed thoroughly. They clearly take their time with you. My cats will remain under the care of Sarah and her team for the rest of their lives.

I cannot express how thankful I am for the vet team here x everyone is so kind, thoughtful and willing to think along with you for the best of your pets ❤️  my cat Lola had some pretty terrible health issues with her thyroid/heart/lungs but she's now more stable after several visits and consults here & the hospital I was reffered to. Couldn't be more thankful! always feels like visiting a homey place when we come here (for me at least. Lola might still have other opinions).
Terribly sweet and caring veterinarian. They guided us incredibly well with our cat Pepper.

I have always been satisfied with veterinarians in the past, but this is the first time I am truly very happy with this vet. It is small-scale, very personal, and that really makes a difference. They think along with you, there is no sense of "upselling," and they provide genuine care. A real asset to the neighborhood!
We brought our cat there, which was taken great care of. The vet took the time to explain to us what was wrong and took the time to answer to our questions.

Very skilled and independent, small-scale veterinary clinic for dogs and cats! Sarah, the veterinarian and dentist, has professionally treated our cat multiple times for his teeth, among other things. We have always trusted her and she has never disappointed us!

Our puppy broke one of his canine teeth while playing, and we were very worried. As soon as we reached out, they managed to fit us in for an emergency appointment and took care of everything from start to finish.

Since Haku needed dental surgery, we were quite nervous, but the entire team was incredibly kind, reassuring and professional. They made us feel comfortable and confident that he was in good hands.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of our little guy. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend them!
Friendly and calm staff, they even take your pet into account if, for example, it cannot be in the waiting room with other animals.

Sarah is a veterinarian with a big heart. Incredibly dedicated, transparent in communication, and provides top-notch care. You can feel that your animal is truly in good hands here. Furthermore, I am satisfied with the entire team that provides loving care. Highly recommended!

We love this vet clinic and the team! They have always been so kind, emphatic and caring towards our Samoyed Appa. Compared to other clinics where everything feels procedural, the team here really takes the time to understand and care about our pets. There was weeks consecutively that Appa will have one different unrelated medical complaint after the other and the team here always took the time and took it seriously, no matter how seemingly small.
Thank you Eva! :-) Regards Sarah
Amazing care for my dog

Very attentive and kind staff who were calm and relaxed with my feisty cat. Visits to the previous vet were always highly stressful for both me and our cat, but this clinic was much better. Highly recommended.

Sarah and Louis possess an empathy for animals that I have seldom seen . They are remarkable humans, who have operated on both my Persian cats . Mainly Sarah , as 2 surgeries were dental . They have a great understanding around the breed.
Also , their understanding about reassuring the owner, an added bonus 😜
The fact that there is transparency around the pricing and not part of the vetinary  conglomerates in the city a plus ! . The aftercare is also amazing ! Sarah is very skilled as a surgeon performing 3 major operations. One with Louis .
When Louis was at the other practice , his compassionate care throughout the cancer treatment and loss of my former cat was so remarkable that I even named my new cat after him!
My cats Amy and Louis could not have been in better hands

I had a wonderful experience at this clinic. Dr. van Hövell is professional, kind, and clearly cares about animals. Most importantly, my dog felt completely at ease and left wagging his tail! Highly recommended for anyone looking for a trustworthy vet.
Nice place, good stuff, good equipment, reasonable prices. Fully satisfied)

I recently changed vets as my previous practice was bought by a PE group and began suggesting pointless and expensive procedures.

After researching I found Westlandgracht, and saw they weren't part of the PE group buying up vets all over NL.

I'm so happy with the switch. Costs are all reasonable, the care they take for pippin is exemplary, they clearly articulate what they'll do (my dog had to have 6 teeth removed!) and they don't try to ring up the costs.

Super happy 😁

Last Friday, I spoke on the phone with, if I remember correctly, Sarina. I asked her if Nexgard Spectra could be ordered for our dog through your practice. Our own vet said they could no longer supply this product, and because our dog is quite prone to allergic reactions, I had a problem. Sarina then contacted my vet, and eventually, a solution has been found. I would like to take this opportunity to thank Sarina in particular very much for her help and for thinking along with me. That was very nice and is greatly appreciated.
Kind regards,
Friendly, comes across as caring. Especially understanding and care for the patient, our tomcat.

I am very satisfied with Westlandgracht Veterinary Clinic. The veterinarians are incredibly skilled and very kind! My dog ​​even let me trim her nails calmly! They always have good advice and know how to put my dog ​​completely at ease. I would highly recommend this veterinarian!!
Thank you! 🙏 😁 …

We visited the team for the first time for dental treatment for both our dog and our cat, and we couldn’t be happier! Everything went perfectly from start to finish. Sarah was fantastic, kind, professional, and very reassuring, and the whole team was equally great.
It’s clear that they genuinely care about the animals they treat, and that made us feel completely at ease. We’ll definitely continue coming here and highly recommend them.
Thank you from Zorro, Leilo, and their happy humans 🙏🏼

Very friendly young team. Professional and skilled. Reassured both dog and owner. My dog ​​recovered quickly after the correct diagnosis and treatment. Very grateful for this and for all the extras they offer. Highly recommended.
Unfortunately I had to put my cat down but Louis was a very accommodating Vet. Very professional  and sympathetic vet. If I will ever get a pet again - this is the place I would go to!

Highly recommended; the veterinarian (Louis) is very genuinely involved in the treatment of our cat. All the staff at the clinic are very friendly and provide good care. Our cat feels much better thanks to all the staff at this clinic.

We also ended up at Westlandgracht Veterinary Clinic via a referral from our vet for extensive dental treatment for our cat Ollie. It was excellent. Sarah provided very clear explanations when scheduling the appointment, during the appointment via email, and on the day itself. The team was also very nice. It was also nice to know that the costs were lower than expected (compared to other vets), several teeth were extracted, and X-rays were even taken. Everything was arranged perfectly, and we also received good dietary advice. That same evening, Ollie was already purring contentedly on our laps, grooming himself, and even eating a little again. 🐱
I recently took my rabbit Pien to Louis' vet. Louis filed my rabbit's molars, and everything is going great again! Completely satisfied, top clinic!

I'd been thinking about switching to a different veterinary clinic for a while. There were several reasons for this, but a major factor was that one of my favorite veterinarians, Louis, had left my previous clinic. Louis has always been a doctor who treats animals with great respect, calmness, and expertise, but who also has an eye for the person behind the animal. That's a very valuable combination.
His departure ultimately felt like the straw that broke the camel's back.

I wanted to find a good, reliable veterinary clinic that wasn't part of a large chain. But where do you even begin?
After browsing online, I came across the website of Dierenkliniek Westlandgracht. The site immediately gave a good impression, but when I looked at the "team" page, there it was... Louis! That honestly felt like a sign that this was the right place for me.

I called right away and spoke with Sarina. From the very first moment, the conversation felt pleasant and personal. She asked questions, listened attentively, and it definitely didn't feel like a typical business call. What was particularly striking was her genuine warmth and obvious love for animals. I also noticed a healthy dose of humor.

My first appointment with my cat Vicki only confirmed that feeling. When I entered the clinic, it immediately felt homely and welcoming. The decor is beautiful: lovely color combinations, unique wallpaper, atmospheric lamps, and even the table by the coffee machine gives the feeling of a living room. Everything radiates peace and love for both animals and people.
Sarina was behind the reception desk, and she was just as friendly in person as she had been on the phone. Fantastic!

Shortly after I arrived, Louis emerged from the treatment room, and it truly felt like seeing an old friend again. We had a relaxed chat, and I was able to explain why I wanted to switch. He understood immediately, precisely because he knows how important Vicki is to me and that I simply want the best for her.

Vicki had a senior checkup and a blood test. She normally doesn't like that at all. Sarina helped with this, holding her calmly and firmly while gently speaking to her and petting her. Despite the nerves, Vicki remained remarkably calm (comparatively speaking). I saw behavior that Vicki normally only displays with me. That speaks volumes to me about how natural and respectful Sarina is with animals.

After the examination, we discussed everything calmly and clearly. When paying, I was struck by how reasonable and fair the prices are. It didn't feel like a place selling unnecessary things at all, but simply honest and genuine veterinary care.
I was given a delicious cup of coffee and they even called a taxi for me. Vicki and I went home feeling very good.

Sincerely, Jerry Veen
